sourceState.note: Local checkout includes other active visual work; do not equate its code with the production-alpha.133 captures or verified production behavior.

observedCapabilities.finding: Procedural HDR environment converted through PMREM to scene.environment exists.
Composer includes conditional half-resolution SSAO, character mask, viewmodel render, bloom, tone composite and conditional AA; low has a no-post tone path.
Some detail maps are derived from albedo; separate authored PBR texture loading also exists.
General material factory uses Lambert; water uses transparent Physical material. B pool reflects detailed surrounding architecture beyond a simple sky environment.
Standard materials with optional detail maps exist. The material path is not uniform across maps.
A lightmap/second-UV path already exists for a Lajes shell; this is not proof of consistent baking across maps.
Character materials preserve existing normal and roughness maps and add custom readability/region effects. PBR is present, not absent.
GLB JSON and embedded WebP metadata inspected. Both include base color, normal and roughness-metal textures. Improving B is not simply switching PBR on.
Prop culling, batching and spatial instancing paths already exist; do not propose reimplementing them as missing.
Quality changes pixel ratio (high up to2, medium1, low0.75) and shadows. Actual device performance was not measured.
The inspected live loaders are GLTFLoader instances without KTX2 registration; vendored loader API support alone does not establish an active GPU-compressed texture pipeline.

recommendedFutureWorkIfResumed: Use B as an art direction with authored material recipes, consistent texture scale and color management; selectively migrate visible Lambert surfaces to Standard rather than enabling complex Physical features everywhere.
Prepare meaningful base color/normal/roughness/metal/AO maps offline, selective silhouette bevels and high-to-low detail baking. A normal map cannot change silhouette, rig or pose.

Extend existing static lightmap/AO/vertex/probe workflow as appropriate; retain restrained dynamic lighting for moving actors. Static bakes trade memory and authoring effort for runtime work and must not double-light materials.
Treat the pool reflection/refraction/caustic combination as a separate high-risk task. Approximate environment reflection is cheaper than correct dynamic reflected geometry at all angles.
Control vegetation/hair transparency, overdraw, shadows and visible detail with LOD, spatial culling/batching and simplified distant assets while preserving layout and competitive visibility.
Evaluate KTX2/Basis GPU compression with hardware-appropriate transcoding and dimension budgets; WebP download savings alone do not establish GPU-memory savings.
Preserve the B palette/material identity across mobile quality levels while reducing resolution, effects, reflection detail and distant geometry. C is not intrinsically guaranteed cheaper.

Only after owner requests resumption, validate a real sample with matched cameras plus motion, representative actors/VFX, physical Android/iOS devices and sustained sessions, frame-time stability, memory and load time.

relativeRiskNotBenchmark.moderate: Credible opaque material finish and static lighting; asset preparation and texture memory remain material costs.
relativeRiskNotBenchmark.high: Correct dynamic water reflections/refractions, very soft dynamic shadows over large areas, dense layered foliage/transparency, volumetric rays and many moving high-detail characters together.
relativeRiskNotBenchmark.unproven: How close to B the whole game can get at acceptable performance on the users' phones. No percentage fidelity, quality score, FPS or schedule promise is supported.

ownerDecisionUnchanged: owner-decision.json; B if feasible/performance acceptable, C fallback; no execution now.
